independent_static_review.scope: Static code/schema/orientation/gates only; no script execution/fixtures/CSV/TESTerrors

input_scope: Only COMPLETE EXTENSION_EVALUATION_RECEIPT and receipted metadata lineage, completed fixed summary CSVs, primary cohort identity/count CSV, and pretruth Source575 split. No error parquet, predictions, raw cells, model load, bootstrap rerun or fit.
completion_and_lineage_required_before_C: corresponding extension truth COMPLETE under c94 operation and exact b120 global once-only claim
orientation: Recorded A-minus-B or negate/reverse opposite difference and CI[-upper,-lower]
evidence_levels: Separately report point>=.005,lowerCI>=-.005,lowerCI>0; supported practical positive increment uses point>=.005 AND lowerCI>0
registered_safety_claim_scope: Primary and strong-history-support require macro+both contexts safety, two valid>=20 original contexts and both nonnegative U20; Manual/Public report their guards without inventing a new hardgate or replacing primary
missingness: NA/nonfinite/undefined existing relative denominator is not a pass; no added epsilon/imputation. Unavailable completion or invalid contract produces UNCOMPUTED, never a performance PASS.
subgroups: Source575 seen/unseen identity counts descriptive only; no subgroup metric or winning-subgroup selection
efficiency_limit: 2790 already computed C-validation errors are available but unused in risk training; original13 has no target-validation-specific risk learner; efficiency over that condition remains uncomputed regardless wins
execution_instruction: Invoke only after Root confirms completed fixed outputs: python checker --evaluation-root COMPLETED_FIXED_EVALUATION_ROOT --output THIS_FOLDER/ACTUAL_INTERPRETATION.json; script refuses existing output or output outside this folder.
